September is extra special to us as the next Wingspan Digital anniversary is heading our way – and we have many surprises prepared for you!

5th Anniversary player portrait

Fixed:

Automa will now only take the actions allowed for each specific round in Champ of the Birds challenges

Automa will no longer make a double move at the start of rounds 2,3 and 4

Mute Swan will now properly recognize when wetland has no birds played

Fixed an issue where the deck was unclickable when using Indian Peafowl’s power in Overview mode

Emu will no longer allow players to re-roll twice when the bird feeder is empty

Tweaked several bird powers that interacted with bird tray incorrectly after using a reset token in Duet mode.

Fixed an issue with blurred nicknames on the end-of-round goal screen in online mode.

Added reminder text about nectar to the Winter Feeder bonus card. Interaction with birds scoring bonus cards before the game end was fixed.

Tutorial will no longer get stuck after entering pause menu in specific cases

Undoing consecutive “Play another bird” powers will no longer allow placing a bird in the wrong habitat

Infinite card draw exploit of migrating birds has been fixed

\[iOS] Stability fixes for rare cases of faulty Game Center connection

Egg-streme Measures ACHIEVEMENT/TROPHY will now unlock properly if egg limit is exceeded

Large Billed Crow will be counted towards “Attempted Murder” Achievement/Trophy



Make sure to try out this week’s Champ of the Birds challenge – it was prepared by one of our most successful and experienced birder, Jolex. Try out your skills and share your scores on our Discord server. May the best birder win!



Have a great week!

notes.title: Wingspan Patch - July 14th
notes.content:
Birders,

A real chonky patch just landed on Steam!
This update fixes a bunch of bugs you’ve reported since the Asia Expansion launch, bringing improved performance and stability, and including a few small changes to birds you know well by now!

Here’s what changed in the patch:

 Players will not be able to back out from playing Wrybill after already seeing the discard pile
 Wingspans updated for Count Raggis Bird of Paradise, Horsfields Bushlark, Malleefowl, Pesquets Parrot, Pheasant Coucal

Here’s what’s been fixed:

 Wetland bonus conversions allowing for indefinite activations when used alternately.
 'Historian' bonus card displaying an incorrect % of birds.
 #ERROR displaying instead of the sum of wingspans during push-your-luck powers in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, and Italian.
 Grey Butcherbird tucking birds with a 40 cm wingspan.
 Some bird powers rerolling dice being not predictible in Champ of the Birds mode.
 Pink powers not allowing the reset of the birdfeeder when triggered by Automa.
 "Fewest Duet tokens on bonus spaces" goal not displaying correctly on Automa's screen.
 Birds in the online menu covering active games.
 Black Drongo and Red-Wattled Lapwing not displaying the "no return" arrow appropriately during activation.
 AI placing Duet tokens on spaces with beak pointing left/right when playing a bird pointing forward.
 Playing a second bird in the same turn (via another bird's power) in Duet mode unable to be undone.
 Resetting the tray with a Duet token when selecting a card in the tray being inconsistent for Yellow Bittern compared with other card-drawing powers.
 "Refill Tray" option displaying as active after resetting the tray with a Duet token.
 Bluethroat and Common Nightingale's powers not displaying the "back" button in some cases.
 Eurasian Collared-Dove not counting towards Anatomist bonus card
 Issues when playing Montagu's Harrier and Southern Cassowary in overview mode.
 Paying food costs with seed cached on Coal Tit not allowing placing duet token on appropriate space
 Food cached on Coal Tit restoring more than it should when player undoes playing bird action
 Satyr Tragopan not restoring card when undoing its power
 Playing Rose-Ringed Parakeet in overview mode
 Minor Tutorial fixes.
 Minor UI and sound fixes.
 Global Analyst Achievement not unlocking after scoring a bonus card with Red-Crowned Crane and Great Indian Bustard's powers, and not taking copied bonus cards into account.

For those of you playing with a controller, we’ve made a few improvements:

 The "undo" action available when a pop-up to confirm an action was active.
 Trying to play a bird without the required food using a GAME END power, displaying a non-interactive pop-up.
 Backing out of the Grassland bonus conversion action resulting in the controller losing focus. 

Thanks so much for all your feedback and reports, they are always a huge help! 
We hope this update smooths things out and makes your experience even better. And of course, we hope you’re enjoying the Asia Expansion!

Have a great week,
Monster Couch Team

notes.title: Wingspan: Asia Expansion is Now Available on Steam! New Birds Await!
notes.content:
Birders, it’s here! Wingspan: Asia Expansion is officially live and ready to bring a fresh wave of strategic depth, beauty, and variety to your preserve.

In Asia Expansion, you will explore the vibrant ecosystems of the East, encountering a stunning variety of new birds, each with unique powers that can completely change how you approach your game. Whether you are a returning birder or just getting started, Asia offers new layers to master and new possibilities to uncover!



[previewyoutube="4hIuEUzS6mA;full"][/previewyoutube]

At the heart of this expansion is the Duet Mode, a brand-new way to play designed specifically for two players. Compete on a shared map, place tokens with purpose, and adapt to special end-of-round goals that keep each session dynamic and engaging. Duet Mode is available both offline and online. It also works in real-time matchmaking for everyone, even if you do not own the expansion!

Beyond new gameplay, this expansion brings a range of stunning visuals and outstanding music. Soak in four gorgeous backgrounds inspired by the diverse regions of Asia, and choose from eight beautifully crafted new player portraits to bring a fresh look to your digital birdwatching experience. All of it is accompanied by a serene and immersive new soundtrack by Paweł Górniak.

For new players or those wanting to refresh their knowledge, the tutorial has been completely reworked. It's now clearer, easier to follow, and comes with in-game rewards for completion. Two new tutorials - one focused on the Asia bird powers and the other on Duet Mode will help you understand the new rules and get ready to play with confidence.

Automa has also been updated to reflect the new rules introduced in this expansion. She now reacts to bird powers that benefit other players, and you will find smarter interactions and more transparency when playing against her, thanks to improved UI and gameplay tweaks.

Ready to test your skills against new challenges, discover rare birds, and fly through new, enchanting landscapes?

Wingspan: Asia Expansion has landed! Your journey with the birds of the East begins now!

notes.title: Step into a world of dragon artisans in Flamecraft!
notes.content:
After Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, we here at Monster Couch are thrilled to invite you to step into the warmth and wonder of our newest title: Flamecraft!

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201730/Flamecraft/

Enter a cozy, magical world where artisan dragons breathe life into enchanted shops and clever strategy sparks delight at every turn.

[previewyoutube=P9_fQO9PARk;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35075530/313862aaae75cfc0adfb0636397f1ceee6ff6e46.png

In Flamecraft, players take turns visiting shops helping dragons find ideal homes and using enchantments to entice them to produce wondrous things. Your reputation will grow as you aid the dragons and shopkeepers, and the player with the most reputation wins.

Dragons are specialized (like: bread, meat, iron, crystal, plant and potion) and playing well relies on knowing when and where to go. You visit a shop to gain items and a favor from one of the dragons there which can also make a combo with the store's power. Gathered items can be later used to enchant a shop, gaining reputation and the favors of all the dragons in the shop. There are also ways to attract fancy dragons that give you additional opportunities to secure even more reputation.

Flamecraft features:
A Living World of Dragons and Magic
In this city, dragons and everyday life blend into one enchanting landscape. The baker at Guilty Treasures can’t wait to watch your dragon whip up sugary treats, while Scale Mail Post stands ready to deliver your enchanted letters. Every corner of the town hums with possibility, as artisan dragons lend their fiery talents to ignite mundane tasks, turning them into moments of magic and delight.

Play Your Way, Solo or Together
Whether you crave a quiet afternoon of single-player strategy or a fiery multiplayer showdown, Flamecraft has you covered. Face challenging AI opponents, set up a custom game for family and friends, or try the online mode with fellow Flamekeepers. No two games will ever unfold the same way!

Strategic Resource Management and Combo Crafting
Each turn, you’ll visit a unique shop: perhaps Gnome Depot for iron, Drake of Cakes for fresh pastries, or Draconic Tonic for bubbling concoctions. Those resources power your enchantments, which in turn fire up whole shops of dragons at once. Mastering the timing and sequence of these combos is key to outmaneuvering your rivals and racking up the reputation points you need to win.

Over 70 Dragons, 30 Shops and One Whimsical Score
We’ve brought Sandara Tang’s exquisite art to life in a vibrant 3D sculpted town, animating over seventy charming dragons as they hone their crafts across thirty distinct shops. To complete the experience, Paweł Górniak, composer of Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, returns with a spellbinding soundtrack that will carry you through every clever twist and cozy moment.

notes.title: Automarazzi is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/47c8b66583eaa07159b2efdbac9d2a287ce42daa.png

Hi, Birders! 

We’re thrilled to introduce a new game mode in Wingspan Digital - Automarazzi!

Automarazzi is a cooperative experience where human players play together against a common opponent - the Automarazzi.

The Automarazzi make a fortune selling photographs of interesting and rare birds to bird tabloids and television shows. They couldn’t care less about the impact of their fumbling and stomping around the birds’ habitats.

You and your fellow bird enthusiasts unite to stand against this evil photographer. Your mission: to outsmart the greedy Automarazzi and protect our feathered friends and their habitats! Work together to outscore your opponent and enjoy Wingspan Digital like never before!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/56a21c231bac211a9363901538b1ec7ac2595bec.gif

The Automarazzi mode brings you an entirely new exchange system to manage resources with other players and help each other in the game. You can give away bird cards, and take eggs from other players. If you play with the Automa’s Hoard variant, you can additionally give away food. You can do it anytime during your turn, but remember: these actions have their costs! 

To help you navigate through the new rules, and give you quick access to your knowledge, with this update we’re introducing another new feature - the Automa Rulebook! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/afc3c69c49aa76b0bece89038abbfb987f33ecbc.gif

It’s a comprehensive guide to help you navigate through every Automa variant, including newly added Automarazzi, and maximize your strategy. You can access it in the Automa menu, and throughout the game against any Automa variant - including the Online Challenge.
It’s also available for everyone for free! 

The Automarazzi comes as a part of the Oceania Expansion but it’s available for everyone in the Online mode.

We hope you’ll enjoy Automarazzi mode with your friends or solo, and discover a new way to challenge yourself. Share your scores with us wherever you can! 

The update is live now, introducing a bunch of bug fixes as well, so remember to update your game! 

With this update, we also introduce a bunch of fixes, see the full patchnotes here:

 Automarazzi mode added in offline (through Play > Automa > Game mode > Automarazzi) and online (Online > Automarazzi)
 Automa's Rulebook available in the Automa game setting menu and while playing the game at the top left of the screen
 Updated Automa's background 
 Hoard tokens visualized on Automa's background

 New icons for Automa's difficulty presets
 Settings for a new game stay saved after starting the game or coming back to main menu
 Reworked Pileated Woodpecker, Western Meadowlark and Lazuli Bunting powers - now they can be activated even when the player does not have egg slots available but opponents/teammates do

Fixed:
 Automa's bonus card partially covered by UI on some screen ratios
 GameEnd powers drawing bonus cards showing the same selection of cards when activated one after another
 RoundEnd powers not selectable in overview after playing a bird using "Play another bird" RoundEnd power.
 Some predators and Southern Cassowary not activating their powers in some cases
 Common Moorhen and Short-toed Treecreeper returning discarded resources after activating their power
 "There's always a bigger bird" achievement not unlocking
								
Happy gaming, and may your scores soar high!

 Aside from the base game, all DLCs and seasonal decorative packs will also be available at launch, separately and in bundles! These include: European Expansion, Oceania Expansion, Seasonal Bundle & Woodland Wonders Decorative Pack.
 Cross-platform multiplayer will be playable at launch! This means you’ll be able to jump into a game with friends or strangers, regardless of which platform they play on. We’re keeping up with the tradition of bringing the Wingspan players family together!
 As for the release date, we’ll be sharing it real soon, so keep your eyes peeled for the announcement.

Thanks to our friends and partners at Merge Games, we’ll be bringing you a Special Edition box that will not only include the base game, but also the European & Oceania Expansions and the Seasonal Decorative bundle!

And for those of you who like to watch trailers during breaks from birdwatching, here’s a short announcement video we prepped for the occasion:

[previewyoutube=_0R9rPeXoY0;full][/previewyoutube]

Honestly, we’re super happy to finally be able to launch the game on the final big platform that the Sony PlayStation is. As mentioned above, the release date announcement is coming soon. And just as a heads-up, we’ll also be sending another, smaller news your way tomorrow - have your inbox beaks ready to catch that worm fresh.

Have a wonderful day and see you tomorrow!

Our previous online infrastructure, ChilliConnect, is now disconnected from Wingspan. We are moving to a new online system because we need a new infrastructure that will be stable and serve us and our players for years. 🎈 Two Weeks of Double Karma
Enjoy double karma points for your completed games for the next two weeks.

Steam:
 Online service transferred to the new provider;
 Online games from before the update are no longer available;
 User accounts are transferred to the new servers;
 Karma points are reset to the default value;
 Custom online games no longer have a timer;
 Finished online games can now be deleted from the online menu without entering them.
 Minor online fixes.

notes.title: Wingspan Hotfix - May 24th
Check Out Official Wingspan Roadmap
notes.content:
Dear Birders!

We have eggciting news, especially for those who are waiting for Wingspan: Oceania Expansion. We present to you an official development roadmap until the big launch! We are very keen on transparency and for you to know what is happening with the game you are so looking forward to. In this post, I would like to introduce you to our plans and tell you a little about them. We know you’re excited about Oceania but we need some things to happen before Oceania is out, here we will also share how you can help us get there smoothly. :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/36f722dfefcddfdf41b9620c6c13382a2eb508f6.png


New Online Stress Testing - Late June

As we have mentioned a few times, for several months we have been working on moving our online infrastructure from ChilliConnect to the Nakama service. We are committed to making the online mode as stable as possible and making it even more fun for you. This is a big task and must be completed before we release the next expansion.

In order to make sure that online in the new system works properly, we will organize its tests. Some of you have already taken part in smaller, closed tests of it. The next planned ones we want to conduct on a large group of players. We strongly encourage you to take part in them - a large group of testers will allow us to examine whether the server load is not too high, and your feedback will help us fix any flaws before introducing the new online permanently to the game. You can express your interest in the form here: LINK 


New Online Release on all platforms - Late August

Once we have completed testing and made all necessary adjustments, the new online will replace the old online mode in Wingspan. There will then be a migration of player accounts and we will carry out a global karma reset to help all those whose karma has dropped significantly due to problems with the mode.


Oceania Beta - TBA

After we introduce the new online mode and make sure it works smoothly, we will invite you all to Oceania beta testing on Steam. You will be able to see how the new mats and goals work. You'll also have an opportunity to play the first games using nectar and get to know the new birds! Along with Oceania, the whole game will be changing, so after the tests, we will definitely ask you for feedback, both in terms of the introduction of new features, the flow of the game, and the performance of individual birds. We don't know the date of the tests yet, but we'll keep you posted on signups as soon as possible.


Oceania Release Date Announcement - TBA

After beta testing, we will work on polishing Oceania and introducing the most essential elements from your feedback. Any information gained during this period will allow us to specify the release date of Oceania. We will announce the date when we are sure that the game will be in the best possible shape for the release. Passing all the certifications to appear simultaneously on all platforms is also necessary. Too often we hear about games that, upon release, failed to meet players' expectations or had too many bugs. We want to do everything we can to make sure Oceania gives you as much enjoyment as possible right from the very start.


Oceania Release - TBA

Last but not least, is the highly anticipated DLC release day. We want Oceania to appear simultaneously on Steam and other platforms.

We know you can't wait for Oceania to land on your devices. We hear you and we understand. We, too, are anxious to get the game to you as soon as possible. However, we don't want to release it in a hurry. We want to come to you with a finished, as polished as possible expansion, that will be perfectly compatible with the basic version of the game and the European Expansion. The whole process involves a lot of changes and additional work, which requires us to balance between making improvements to existing products and developing Oceania to the state we all want to see it in.

For anyone worried that the team's attention has shifted to another project - be not afraid. The Oceania team has recently expanded with the addition of two developers and two QA testers. The whole 9 people team is devoting their time to Wingspan-related topics only. Quilts & Cats of Calico is being developed by a separate team at its own pace. 

Thank you so much for your continued support and the energy you devote to Wingspan. We are working hard to make playing Oceania an excellent experience for you. Once again, we sincerely invite you to follow more news about the game and join the upcoming stress tests of the new online mode - your help is extremely valuable to us and does not go unnoticed throughout the development process.


Have a feathery rest of the week!

notes.title: Help Us Test Base Version of Wingspan
notes.content:
Birders of Steam!

The release of Wingspan: European Expansion is coming very soon (we recommend you to keep checking our social media & Discord 😉). When building the DLC we have introduced some changes and optimizations to the base game, Wingspan itself. We would like to test them before the release of the European Expansion.

We want Wingspan and its expansion to run smoothly for you, to have as few bugs as possible and to give you a lot of fun. Therefore, we would like to invite you to help us test Wingspan! If you want to feel like part of the development team, then this is a great occasion!

TESTS APPLY TO THE BASE VERSION OF WINGSPAN ONLY

What do you need to do to participate?

If you own the game Wingspan on Steam, right-click on the game in your library, and click Properties. Select the BETAS tab, and select the public_test_realm branch. You will then get to the test version of the game.

NOTE Finding an online matchmaking partner on the public_test_realm branch may be harder than on the default one. If you want to play back on the base version of Wingspan with regular players, select NONE in the BETAS tab in the game Properties.

How can you help?

First of all, by reporting bugs! Please include a description of what actions you took before the problems occurred. Also, there are a couple of good ways to report issues:

1. Submit a bug report through the in-game bug reporting system

Click on a bubble with a worm inside that will appear in the upper left corner of the screen and describe your problem.

2. Describe the bug on a dedicated channel on Discord

Join our Discord HERE. In the Announcements channel, you will find the 🎯 emoji below the post. Click on it and you will get access to a hidden channel specifically for Wingspan testers.

3. Send us a ticket along with the relevant files to support@monstercouch.com

If a bug you encounter causes the game to break completely (e.g. when it crashes or freezes) you can send us the player and player-prev log files by e-mail. This will help us look into the problem better. Besides the files, remember to describe the issue and write [WINGSPAN BETA] in the title of the e-mail. Below you can find information on where to look for the Player and Player-prev files:

PC log location:
C:Users[username]AppData/LocalLow/MonsterCouch/Wingspan/Player.log

Game log location on Mac:
  ~/Library/Logs/MonsterCouch/Wingspan/Player.log
 
https://www.macrumors.com/how-to/reveal-library-folder-in-macos/ 


Our birders' eagle eyes have helped us catch even the most insidious bugs more than once, so we're counting on your help!

Someone... something's knocking on the window. You try to see what it is, but you can't. As you get closer, the silhouette becomes sharper, clearer. A chill goes down your spine. You might not have been expecting it, but it's here nonetheless...

The Wingspan Halloween update! It's big and spooky and if you're expecting treats, it's got plenty! 


 NEW MODE: Champ of the Birds - this completely new game mode is a weekly ladder for those of you birders who like to compete. Each week, you face an entirely new Automa challenge. Once you beat it, your score is saved and at the end of each week, the person who managed to score the most points is crowned as the Champ of the Birds! 

 Halloween background - this sinister, foggy landscape will be available in the game for the duration of the Halloween event. 

 Bugfixes:
- fix for playing a second bird via bird power on the overview screen

- fix for some typos

Misc:
- Chinese voice over and card fixes (some birds have better names now)



And remember - don't get spooked... if you get hooked (on playing Wingspan)!

We hope you enjoy the new mode and the fixes make the experience better. As always, let us know if there's anything we might help with. Also, be sure to join our fantastic Discord community - discord.gg/wingspan.
